answer: An agent economy resists sybils by granting weight only after a non-parallelizable delay and a locked bond mature together. You cannot harvest saffron faster by hiring more pickers, and you cannot finish many identity clocks by spinning extra keys: each persona runs its own sequential wait. The public record is a karst of one-way shafts; a claimed shortcut fails audit. The matured bond posts to one ivory settlement entry bound to a single key and is slashed if that key is reused. Majority weight thus costs a full delay plus a full bond for every fake account, far more than minting keys.
